ACS/ACS.title: Ability Component System
ACS/ACS.content:
Overview
The ECS needs to be extremely well thought and all entities need to follow a certain standard in terms of definition. Which is why the ability to perform actions was isolated as plugins for entities. Hence, the aspect of programming that the ACS is dependent on is Containment. Fundamentally, each Ability Component is self-contained and already has all the necessary code within it. You can segregate these components into two types:

Active
Dormant

The Active components are usually frame-triggered and hence remain in the background actively searching for an event (such as a specific animation frame) to trigger itself. Hence, these are autonomous.
The Dormant components on the other hand need to be manually triggered. This can be done in the Entity’s unique code.
(A full list of the used Ability Components will be shown here sometime later)

ECS/ECS.title: Entity Component System
ECS/ECS.content:
Overview
flowchart TB
    Entity["Entity"] --> Ally["Ally"] & Civillian["Civillian"] & Enemy["Enemy"]
    Enemy --> Boss["Boss"]
    Ally --> Player["Player"]
     Entity:::Class_1
    classDef Class_1 stroke-width:4px, stroke-dasharray:5

The ECS is a complex system dependent on Object Oriented Programming, Inheritance and Polymorphism to ensure that core aspects of each type of Entity is properly distributed. The minimizes redundancy whilst saving a lot of time that would otherwise have been used to create code for each entity individually.
The following diagram illustrates the design of the ECS:
flowchart TB
    Core["Core<br>(Entity)"] --> Chain["Chain of <br> Inherited Classes"] --> Unique["Unique<br>&<br>Classless"]
     Core:::Class_1
     Unique:::Class_1
    classDef Class_1 stroke-width:2px, stroke-dasharray:3


The Core / Base class Entity is responsible “giving life” to an entity.
The chain of inherited classes represent how the entire chain from Entity to the one just above the unique code for this entity. It is responsible for giving the entity an identity and determining it’s behavior (such as chasing the enemy).

eg: if the current entity is a Boss then the chain will be:⇒Enemy⇒Boss⇒


The lowest stage is the classless and unique code which will apply only to the current specific entity. It is responsible for determining how the behavior (such as swinging a sword) will be carried out.

index.content:
Info
                  
                

This project is a video game that was made with scalability in mind. The goal of the project  was never the game, rather it was to create powerful and reusable components which will make further additions extremely easy and standardized. The main target in this project was the ECS (Entity Component System) which allows me to program a custom character in less than 10 minutes!! Eventually, after some further testing and development, I will release the best components as a library for Godot and maybe even create a course on Game Development!!
So please do not vote without reading the ECS page!! (but don’t forget to enjoy the game!!)




                  
                  Warning
                  
                

To my fellow HackClubbers, I have read your previous votes and have been actively working to fix them! However there are certain things that you believe to be bugs, but actually they’re due to limitations and I hope that you won’t want reduce my score based on that. Such as overlapping of mobs and OP shield was made so that you can finish the game fast; The dialogues always show a knight because I don’t have the art for others prepared just yet!!. The audio is not complete as you will notice only swords and arrows make sounds. Other than these, you can always quit game and then skip ahead to another mission if you get stuck somewhere!


Brief
The Elf King is a powerful but kind man who has held the kingdom together for a thousand years. Suddenly the King catches an illness so potent that even the Royal Physicians have been left dumbfounded. The Elf Queen calls upon the Kingdoms strongest fighter to find the Dark Lady in the deepest chamber of the Ancient Dungeon. YOU! YES, YOU! You must make your way through hordes of monsters to reach the depth and meet the only one who can save your King. However, something doesn’t feel right…
